tasks.title: Curate references and private manifest
tasks.acceptance: Verified PAR/INV labels and real utterance timing for all five pilot .cha references; private manifest row per session; participant-disjoint split confirmed; denoiser checkpoints and openSMILE license sign-off recorded.
tasks.note: Human task, no code. Blocks T8 only; T1-T7 can be built and tested without it.

tasks.title: Manifest loader, hash gate, uncapped scorer, N0/N1 wiring
tasks.acceptance: Hash mismatch raises SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH before any decode; uncapped SyER/CER/WER returns values above 1.0; N0/N1 reuse the existing compare baseline/vad_asr paths.

tasks.title: P0 profile: bandpass, GSM round trip, loudnorm
tasks.acceptance: 16 kHz mono output with input sample count preserved; normalization_type recorded; dynamic-mode fallback detected on a synthetic high-LRA input; CODEC_UNAVAILABLE/LOUDNORM_FAILED on failure; tests skip without ffmpeg.

tasks.title: DeepFilterNet3 adapter, isolated environment
tasks.acceptance: Isolated-env subprocess worker preserves duration/alignment; missing checkpoint/env raises DENOISER_UNAVAILABLE with no network download; no df/torchaudio.backend import in say_transcribe's own environment.

tasks.title: FullSubNet adapter, isolated environment
tasks.acceptance: Same isolated-worker acceptance shape as T3, against the FullSubNet worker at 16 kHz.
tasks.note: Depends on the private CP1 checkpoint (p001 run of N0/N1/P0/PD) completing first, per PLAN-2026-09-25.md.

tasks.title: Coverage metrics against frozen PAR intervals
tasks.acceptance: Coverage and retained-utterance fraction computed with the 50%-overlap definition; boundary case at exactly 50% tested; metric function is arm-agnostic.

tasks.title: Acoustic pack + PAR-only eGeMAPS
tasks.acceptance: extract_acoustic_features called on a pre-selected mono array (stereo downmix path never invoked); openSMILE excludes INV and <1s utterances; missing opensmile raises FEATURE_EXTRACTION_FAILED instead of NaN rows.

tasks.title: Selection, statistics, redacted summary
tasks.acceptance: Gates, no-worse-than-P0, and 1.0-point tie-break unit-tested at boundaries; bootstrap resamples participants (seed 42, 2000); no-denoiser-selected path tested; summary contains no transcript text, absolute paths, or participant mapping.

tasks.title: Real dev + held-out run, RESULTS doc
tasks.acceptance: Held-out result reported even if worse; no candidate switch after seeing held-out data; any docs/-committed artifact is cohort-level aggregates only.
tasks.note: Manual run, not a code task. Blocked on T0 (curated references) and the private CP2 freeze checkpoint after T7.
